const std = @import("std");

    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<p>Before SVG.</p><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"><script>alert('svg-xss')</script><text>SVG text</text></svg><p>After SVG.</p>", null);
